method: Ranked by claude-sonnet-5-5, which read 12 of 14 shortlisted pieces

picks.title: Qualcomm’s Oryon 3 Reaches the Top
picks.author: Chester Lam
picks.why_it_matters: Microbenchmark teardown of Oryon 3: 9-wide core, 2048-entry zero-bubble branch footprint, 5 GHz clocks, and why skipping dual taken branches may be a timing tradeoff.

picks.title: Anima, Bicameral
picks.author: Scott Alexander
picks.why_it_matters: Scott Alexander weighs two opposed AI-consciousness programs, making AIs provably non-conscious versus drawing out their psychology, and tests each plan's weak points.

picks.title: Marc Bloch’s physical and intellectual courage
picks.author: Margareta Melén
picks.why_it_matters: Marc Bloch's life as historian and Resistance organiser, and his argument in The Historian's Craft that the past and present can only be understood through each other.

picks.title: Meaningful Human-in-the-Loop Checking of GenAI Synthesis for Restricted Languages
picks.author: Murat (noreply@blogger.com)
picks.why_it_matters: LLM-generated specs lose the redundancy that makes verification work; PICK restores it by having users classify concrete scenarios where candidates disagree, with user-study results.

picks.title: Underrated reasons to be thankful VI
picks.author: dynomight
picks.why_it_matters: A run of odd, concrete mechanisms, from tear drainage to why Earth never firestorms and why grids use AC, told in a strong voice.
